product.description: backlight module for luminous ceilings and light boxes: 49 Nichia 757 mid-power LEDs on a 290 x 290 mm board, built to order at CRI 70 to 99 and 1800 to 7800 K; here 3000 K at CRI 95, laid in the plenum over a laylight's glass
product.codeBasis: the configurator's product code; the configured variant has no article number of its own

light.fluxBasis: not published for the configuration: the maker gives 24 lm per LED at CRI 95 and 31 lm per LED at CRI 95 H6, without their colour temperature or drive
light.beamName: bare mid-power LEDs, near Lambertian, behind the laylight's diffusing face

electrical.control: constant-voltage 24 V, dimmable, with an onboard switch for three levels

housing.dimensionBasis: the module's board, 290 x 290 x 7 mm; a laylight is a field of modules, whose extent the room gives
housing.mounting: laid in the plenum over the laylight's glass

photometricFile.note: The maker publishes no LDT or IES file for the configurable module.

sources.title: Lumistrips, BackMatrix-49-3080 Configurable Nichia LED Module White CRI 70-99 1800-7800K 24V 49 LEDs 11.42x11.42 in

unverified: The module's flux and power at 3000 K and CRI 95: the maker gives flux per LED by CRI class only, and up to 25 W per module, so the record stands unlit until the configured module's figures are obtained.
How many modules a square metre of the Salon's and the Classical Hall's laylights takes, and at what depth; the room gives the extent.
